Title: M:tG type control Question: Blood Doll

Messages.Author: Nate Williams
Messages.Body:
If I play a Blood Doll on one of my vampires, and that vampire comes
under the control of another player, do I still get to use the Blood
Doll, does the new controller get it, is it burned, or what?

Nate Williams, Cameron's Toady

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>If I play a Blood Doll on one of my vampires, and that vampire comes
>under the control of another player, do I still get to use the Blood
>Doll, does the new controller get it, is it burned, or what?

The errata/rules clarification or whatever for Blood Doll states that whomever
controls the vampire w/ Blood Doll, also controls the Blood Doll. So when the
other Methusaleh gains control of that vampire, HE, not YOU gets to use it.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <19990911224445...@ng-fr1.aol.com>,

halc...@aol.com (Halcyan 2) wrote:
> >If I play a Blood Doll on one of my vampires, and that vampire comes
> >under the control of another player, do I still get to use the Blood
> >Doll, does the new controller get it, is it burned, or what?
>
> The errata/rules clarification or whatever for Blood Doll states
> that whomever controls the vampire w/ Blood Doll, also controls
> the Blood Doll.

Not quite. The official way to play the card matches the Sabbat
card text: "Put this card on a vampire you control. During his
or her master phase, the Methuselah controlling the vampire with
this card may move 1 blood from the vampire to his or her blood
pool or from his or her blood pool to the vampire."

> So when the other Methusaleh gains control of
> that vampire, HE, not YOU gets to use it.

True.
